name: dhvani_eval

subsets.sequential: multi-speaker clips, no overlap (diarization + per-language ASR baseline)
subsets.sources: isolated single-speaker utterances (clean per-language ASR; mixture atoms)
subsets.registers: real English (40) + inter-sentential Hindi-English code-switch (24, constructed from real speech) from commotion/Bilingual-Hindi-English-ASR-Lt-30; fills the pure-English and code-switch WER registers
subsets.vaani: real Project Vaani slice (24 clips across Hindi/Bengali/Assamese; 3 transcribed) — accent/dialect diversity + noise
subsets.nirantar: real Nirantar slice (24 clips, official E2E-prefix via fetch_nirantar.py; audio-only) — transcribed-speech corpus

known_gap: Registers added via fetch_codeswitch.py: pure-English and (inter-sentential) code-switch are real speech. Remaining upgrade: single-speaker INTRA-sentential code-mix needs a gated MUCS set (accept its license, set MUCS_REPO).
